summary: This bill amends the tax code so people with direct primary care arrangements (fixed-fee primary care only, capped at $150/month) can still use health savings accounts, by excluding those arrangements from counting as disqualifying coverage and allowing their fees as HSA-eligible expenses.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow individuals with direct primary care arrangements to remain eligible for health savings accounts and treats these arrangement fees as medical expenses. This effectively expands the tax-advantaged use of HSAs, leading to a reduction in taxable income for those utilizing these arrangements, thus lowering taxes for some individuals.
